news.title: 'Falklands issue was a special ingredient': Lautaro lifts lid on Argentina’s World Cup grudge match against England
news.lede: Lautaro Martinez has revealed how Argentina’s long-running dispute with England over the Falkland Islands added an emotional edge to their 2026 World Cup semifinal, describing the clash as far more than a football match and dedicating his decisive goal to veterans of the 1982 war. The Inter Milan striker scored a 92nd-minute winner as Argentina came from behind to beat England 2-1 in Atlanta on July 15, booking their place in a second consecutive World Cup final. The goal has since taken on a significance beyond the result, particularly among Argentinians who continue to regard the conflict over the islands as a defining chapter in their national history. In an interview with AFA Estudio, Martínez became emotional when shown footage of a Malvinas War veteran breaking down in tears while celebrating his goal.

news.title: FIFA unveils official brand of the 2027 World Cup, which will be held in Azerbaijan and Uzbekistan
news.lede: Today FIFA unveiled the official brand of the FIFA U-20 World Cup 2027™. The brand invites a new generation of football stars to write history at the tournament, which will be held in Azerbaijan and Uzbekistan. The official slogan — "This game is for you" — is addressed both to young footballers and to the fans supporting them. This was reported to 1news.az by the Association of Football Federations of Azerbaijan (AFFA).

news.title: Bibiano Fernandes Outlines India U-15's FIFA World Cup Strategy
news.lede: India U-15 head coach Bibiano Fernandes details his strategic vision for the upcoming FIFA U-15 World Cup and Festival in Baku, Azerbaijan, focusing on foundational skills, tactical adaptability, and character development for his young squad. India U-15 head coach Bibiano Fernandes wants his young wards to develop a strong footballing foundation, tactical flexibility and good character as they prepare for the FIFA U-15 World Cup and Festival in Baku, Azerbaijan, from October 22 to 31. India have been placed in Group K alongside Bahrain, Cameroon, Grenada, Laos and Senegal, with the Blue Colts set to begin their campaign against Laos on October 24 at the Hovsan Competition Complex.

news.title: Unity EURO Cup 2026 brings record 22 teams together in Coverciano to celebrate inclusion through football
news.lede: The fifth edition of the tournament organised by UEFA and in partnership with UNHCR took place on 15 October at the Italian Football Federation’s technical centre, bringing together refugees and players from host communities across Europe. The Unity EURO Cup returned on 15 October for its fifth edition, with a record 22 teams gathering at Coverciano, the Italian Football Federation’s iconic national technical centre near Florence. Organised by UEFA and in partnership with UNHCR, the UN Refugee Agency, the tournament celebrates the power of football to unite people from different backgrounds and support the social inclusion of refugees. This year’s edition featured four more teams than in 2025, reflecting the continued growth of the initiative and its reach across Europe.
